ideas.title: Minnesota's Efforts to Combat Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate Minnesota's efforts to create an office of inspector general and pass integrity bills to prevent and investigate fraud.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to analyze the effectiveness of these efforts and potential challenges in implementation.
questions: What are the key provisions of the integrity bills?
How will the office of inspector general be funded?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover the state's strategy to combat fraud and potential challenges in implementation.

ideas.title: HISD's Special Education Services Under Scrutiny
ideas.description: Investigate HISD's plans to restructure special education services and potential non-compliance with federal regulations.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to analyze the potential impact on disabled students and the district's compliance with federal regulations.
questions: What are the specific changes planned for special education services?
How will these changes affect disabled students?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential non-compliance and the impact on disabled students.
